name: engineering-report-stack
description: Create and maintain traceable engineering WebUI reports using Report-as-Code, canonical JSON/YAML data, JSON Schema validation, diagrams, citations, evidence, interactive exploration, and reusable Agent Skills.

interface.shortDescription: Build clean, traceable engineering WebUI reports from canonical data
interface.longDescription: Architect, create, migrate, refactor, validate, and review technical WebUI reports with stable IDs, source traceability, evidence, diagrams, impact analysis, JSON Schema validation, reusable components, and deterministic generation.
defaultPrompt: Create or update this engineering report using canonical data, traceability, diagrams, evidence, schema validation, and generated views. Inspect dependencies before editing.
